_source.section: Cancel payout item → Sample response (POST /v1/payments/payouts-item/{id}/cancel, 200 OK)
_source.note: Retained as the documented success shape. On 2026-10-29 the sandbox could not produce it: an UNCLAIMED item answered 400 BATCH_NOT_COMPLETED while its batch was still processing and 500 INTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR after the batch completed (cancel-batch-not-completed-400.json, cancel-internal-service-error-500.json). The unit test that reads RETURNED as cancelled therefore still runs on this official sample; whether the sandbox can return it at all is the open question in docs/research/paypal-sandbox-spike.md §(d).
